normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Close proximity to the beach- 6- passenger electric golf cart- Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly Entertainment- 2 Large Community Pools and Barbecue Areas- Fitness Facility- 3 Adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Find sun-soaked, family-friendly fun at Salty Bottom Bungaleaux, a 2-story townhome with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms that comfortably sleeps 8. Located in the beautiful Prominence community of Inlet Beach, which includes 2 resort-style community pools and a fitness center, guests are only a short walk from dining, bars, shops, and entertainment at The Big Chill. This home comes with complimentary bikes and is a quick 7-minute ride from the beach!High ceilings, a muted color palette, and wood-grain tile flooring greet guests entering the open-concept kitchen, living, and dining space. Delight in creating a culinary masterpiece in the thoughtfully designed kitchen, equipped with Electrolux appliances, quartz countertops, and a farmhouse sink. The dining table seats 6, with 3 more seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area is a plush sofa, matching armchairs, a 55” Smart TV, and a Sonos soundbar. Through the glass doors is the spacious porch, which overlooks a peaceful, wooded Deer Lake State Park preserve. A laundry room down the hall is convenient for longer trips.Upstairs, discover a primary bedroom with a king bed, 43” Smart TV, and private bathroom. Additional sleeping accommodations include a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. Both have a 32” Smart TV.With a coveted location and quick beach access, enjoy everything Inlet Beach offers at Salty Bottom Bungaleaux. Easily explore the area with 3 complimentary adult bikes, a golf cart, and parking for up to 3 vehicles—1 in the garage and 2 in the driveway. There are 2 nearby public beach accesses. Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access is a 7-minute bike ride away. Head east on Milestone Drive and turn right onto Pine Lands Loop. Take a left onto Milestone Drive, then a right onto Prominence Square. Upon reaching East County Highway 30A, turn left and continue for about 1 mile. For guests who prefer to drive, Walton Dunes Public Beach Access is a 7-minute drive from the property. Book this lovely townhome today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo** The community north pool is heated, seasonally, during fall and early spring.
